title: Cloud posture coverage — CSPM-attested resources
summary: Share of in-scope cloud resources covered by a CSPM baseline attestation in the evaluation window. Direct measure of how much of the cloud estate the cloud_misconfiguration playbook can see into. Anchored on NIS2 Article 21(2)(i) (asset management) and DORA Article 9 (ICT systems hygiene).

target.rationale: Coverage floor below which posture-finding completeness degrades nonlinearly.

measurement.formula: 100 * count(distinct resource_uid attested by CSPM baseline in window) / count(distinct in-scope cloud resources).

inputs.name: attested_resources
inputs.description: distinct resources appearing in cloud-resource-inventory telemetry within the window

external_refs.name: DORA Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 9 — protection and prevention
